title: public_ip Model
description: AI-scaffolded schema for JSON-driven public_ip definitions — verify field constraints before use.

public_ips.description: Map keyed by a stable logical id. The key becomes the for_each key in Terraform.

resource_group_name.description: Must match the "name" of an entry in resource-group.json.

allocation_method.description: Defines how the public IP address is assigned. Use 'Static' for a permanent IP address that doesn't change, or 'Dynamic' for an IP address that is assigned when the resource is started and may change when stopped.

ddos_protection_mode.description: The DDoS protection mode for the public IP. Controls the level of distributed denial-of-service attack protection applied to this IP address.

ddos_protection_plan_id.description: The resource ID of an Azure DDoS Protection Plan to associate with this public IP address for enhanced DDoS protection.

domain_name_label.description: An optional DNS label that creates a fully qualified domain name (FQDN) for the public IP in the format: label.region.cloudapp.azure.com.

edge_zone.description: Specifies the Edge Zone within the Azure region where this public IP should be created, for scenarios requiring edge computing capabilities.

idle_timeout_in_minutes.description: The timeout in minutes for idle TCP connections. Determines how long a TCP connection can remain idle before being closed.

ip_tags.description: A map of IP tags to associate with the public IP address, used for routing or categorization purposes (e.g., routing preferences or service tags).

ip_version.description: The IP version to use for the public IP address. Typically 'IPv4' or 'IPv6'.

public_ip_prefix_id.description: The resource ID of a public IP prefix from which to allocate this public IP address, useful for allocating IPs from a predefined range.

reverse_fqdn.description: The reverse fully qualified domain name (reverse DNS) associated with this public IP address for reverse DNS lookup scenarios.

sku.description: The SKU (pricing/performance tier) of the public IP address, such as 'Basic' or 'Standard', which affects features and availability guarantees.

sku_tier.description: The SKU tier for the public IP, such as 'Regional' or 'Global', which determines the scope and routing capabilities of the IP address.

zones.description: A set of availability zones where the public IP address should be deployed for high availability (e.g., ['1', '2', '3']).
